origin.missingForDetectorPrediction: Absolute acceptance of the specified peak for photons emitted in the stated source geometry and acquisition regime.

operation.calculation: Multiply the source-event probability by the conditional probability that this detector registers that event in the selected peak.

limits: Match the branch, emitted line energy, geometry and event selection. The time window is on emission, with eventual peak registration in a live acquisition. A detector timestamp cutoff, chance counts, or unresolved coincidence summing needs a separate response model.
